:::{#def-sum-of-elements}
#### Sum of the elements of a vector

The **sum of the elements** of a vector $\vx \in \reals^p$
is the [sum](algebra.qmd#def-summation) of its entries:

$$
\sumof{\vx} \eqdef \sumip x_i.
$$

In words, $\sumof{\vx}$ is the entries of $\vx$ added together.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-sum-of-elements}
#### The sum of the elements of a vector with three entries

For $\vx = (2, -1, 5)$,

$$
\ba
\sumof{\vx}
&= 2 + (-1) + 5
&& \text{(definition of the sum of the elements, with } p = 3 \text{)}
\\
&= 6.
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
